item.title: MLGW crews repairing ruptured gas line in Raleigh neighborhood
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. — Several hundred Memphis, Light, Gas, & Water customers in Raleigh are impacted by a ruptured gas line that crews are working to repair Sunday morning, according to MLGW officials. item.title: 'Indicators' of possible terrorism in deadly Austin mass shooting: FBI
item.description: Two people are dead and 14 more are injured after the early morning shooting. The alleged gunman was fatally shot by officers, according to authorities.

item.title: Nine hospitalized after mass shooting at Cincinnati concert venue
item.description: At least nine people were hospitalized after a shooting at a Cincinnati, Ohio, nightclub and concert venue early Sunday morning.
